entries.description: The social media scheduler for people and their AI agents, as an MCP server: write posts, schedule them and publish them to Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky and more. Sign in with an API key of a staqly workspace (Bearer token).
representativeQueries: schedule a LinkedIn post for tomorrow at 9:00
publish this announcement to Instagram, X and Threads
plan a week of social media posts
